_comment: SME sign-off ledger for production tutor content. A skill graph can only back an authored coverageMatrix cell if (a) its file version is NOT a -draft, (b) it has a non-empty signoffs entry below, AND — since remediation Sprint 01 — (c) the tutor subject item bank carries >=3 real production items at that band (the promotion guard in scripts/curriculum-coverage-check.mjs enforces all three; the item bar can never be satisfied by editing this file). Every entry carries a tier: sme_signoff (credentialed curriculum designer + SpEd specialist) | owner_attestation | engineering_baseline. Non-sme tiers keep the gate green only together with the item bar, and each such authored band emits a warning until a real SME signoff lands. Schema: docs/quality/tutor-content-signoffs.schema.md.
